tips.text: Run the whole Coda loop solo; other players' Duets eat your spawn rolls and a squad Showdown is one fight per player for one extra Heartcell each.
Abort the moment a correct-Antivirus stab lands; the progress banks, but a Quick Correct Heartcell is lost.
Bring Revenant to the Showdown; Mesmer Skin ignores the stage's Magnetic damage, which strips Overguard from Rhino, Dante, Styanax and Kullervo in one graze.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin goes straight through shields.
Equip three different Antivirus mods from the first Duet instead of testing one at a time.
Run only Coda-controlled nodes (tentacles on the POM-2 map); a Duet never spawns anywhere else.
Slot Quick Correct once you know the Antivirus; each stab has a 10% chance of a bonus Heartcell for the whole squad.
Run the Showdown solo; non-host players often miss the stage telegraphs and a band member can spawn invisible and block the fight.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing and Acolytes.
Expect about an hour for a first Coda and much less after; players call it the healthiest adversary loop.
Players resent that the farm opens long before Mastery Rank 17 and the Heartcells sit unspent until then.
